overview:
**Extreme fire danger continues today across the Montrose (High Elevation) zone, driven by bone-dry fuels (ERC 97%) and low humidity.**
- Danger eases through the week: Extreme today, dropping to Very High Tue–Wed, then High Thu–Sun as ERC falls from 97% toward the upper 60s-80s.
- Hot, breezy conditions persist: NE winds near 9 mph, min humidity 22%, high near 87°F, with only a slight afternoon storm chance.
- 2 of 7 local watchout thresholds are met (ERC and minimum RH); no Red Flag Warning is currently posted for this area per NWS.
- Stage 2 Fire Restrictions remain in effect across Gunnison County, Montrose County, Ouray County, and San Miguel County, plus Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison National Forests and BLM Uncompahgre Field Office lands — no campfires, charcoal grills, or open burning.
- Nearby fire activity: the Gold Mountain Fire near Ouray is at 39,532 acres and 90% contained; the Elk Fire on the GMUG is 6,760 acres and 36% contained, with a command team transition underway.
